title: Yemen Interior Minister: Iran seeking to militarize Bab al-Mandeb through the Houthis

description: DUBAI: Israeli human rights group B’Tselem has accused Israel of pursuing what it calls an “elimination project” aimed at dismantling Palestinian collective life in the occupied West Bank. description: DUBAI: The US House of Representatives has gone into an early recess without voting on a Republican lawmaker’s bid to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the US’ war on Iran. Wesley Hunt of Texas, a former Army officer, to be his new ambassador to Saudi Arabia. title: Oil prices extend losses as fears of Middle East supply disruptions ease
description: RIYADH: Oil prices eased in Asian trade on Thursday, extending ​losses on reports of Saudi Arabia offering extra crude cargoes through Oman, which reduced fears of supply ‌disruptions, but stayed above $100 on concerns about the Middle East conflict expanding. Brent crude futures dropped 19 cents, or 0.2 percent, to $105.64 a barrel by 06:47 a.m. Saudi time, while US West Texas Intermediate futures were down 33 cents, or 0.3 percent, at $102.10.

title: Lebanon’s Aoun meets Macron in Paris as France backs army support talks
description: DUBAI: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun arrived at the Elysee Palace in Paris on Thursday, where he was received by French President Emmanuel Macron for a working meeting. The two presidents discussed efforts to end Israeli attacks on Lebanon amid Lebanese-American-Israeli negotiations and a framework agreement, according to the Lebanese presidency. title: Iran war has cost $38 billion, depleted two-thirds of US missile interceptors, CBO says
description: The U.S. military has incurred about $38 billion in costs from combat operations against Iran, a new Congressional Budget Office analysis found.

title: Ukraine live: Ukraine accuses Russia of striking ship in Black Sea as explosions shake Kyiv
description: Russia struck a Tanzanian-flagged civilian ship in the Black Sea, killing its captain, Ukraine said Thursday, after loud explosions were heard across Kyiv overnight. Authorities have issued a missile alert in the capital, an AFP journalist reported. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

title: Lebanon: Emmanuel Macron welcomes Joseph Aoun to Paris for Middle East talks
description: French President Emmanuel Macron is hosting Lebanese President Joseph Aoun in Paris for talks focused on Lebanon's security and wider Middle East tensions, with Jordan's King Abdullah II also taking part in the meeting. FRANCE 24's Luke Shrago and Kethevane Gorjestani have the analysis from Paris.
